name: RetrieveEmailsFromOutlook
label: Retrieve Emails from Outlook
description: Retrieves email messages from a specified Outlook folder. Optionally filters by unread status or subject.

fields.name: OutlookApplication
fields.label: Outlook Application
fields.description: The Outlook Application object used to retrieve emails.

fields.name: FolderName
fields.label: Folder Name
fields.description: The name of the folder to retrieve emails from. Example: 'Inbox', 'Sent', 'Junk'

fields.name: FilterSubject
fields.label: Filter Subject
fields.description: Optional: Filter emails containing this text in the subject.

fields.name: OnlyUnread
fields.label: Only Unread
fields.description: If true, only unread emails are retrieved.

fields.name: EmailMessages
fields.label: Email Messages
fields.description: Returns the list of retrieved email messages as MailItem objects.
